issue.title: routing: under auto session keeping, a provider's own accounts never go back to the first after it recovers
issue.body:
Found while looking into a Codex report (X, WalterAIBuilder, 2026-11-04; fix for the sign-in side is f177c36a9 / v0.1.2905).

With session keeping on auto, the return-to-first check only applies to groups: `inOrder := isGroup && …` in internal/gateway/gateway.go (~2841). So under In order (or Smart), a conversation that moved to a provider's second account stays on it after the first account recovers, for as long as its cache is warm (up to an hour idle between turns for ChatGPT accounts, `chatGPTCold` in internal/gateway/affinity.go). The user sees the second account's quota spent while the first, preferred one has room.

This is the same case as the group fix; a provider's own accounts were left out. Not reproduced with real accounts yet.

comments.body:
A fix is on [the fork branch](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/tree/fix/5178-provider-account-recovery), commit [8a17b62e0](https://github.com/skygunner/magpie/commit/8a17b62e06a52c6dd8e67a01225b3b7dcb3001fb), based on `ed0ab567`.

The existing stand-in mechanism now also recognizes an earlier account of the same provider outside a group. In Auto, when that account is ready and routing places it first, it gets the next user turn. A tool continuation with sealed reasoning stays on its current account; Session/Strict keep it too. A healthy account chosen on its merits keeps its cache. The Routing explanation and translations describe both provider accounts and group members.

Local HTTP tests with two fake Codex accounts reproduce Ordered and Smart Auto sticking to the second account on the base. Parent race verification passes all six routing/affinity combinations, the healthy-account cache control, and existing group stand-in/provider fallback regressions. Gateway vet and full `nogui` build pass. Browser Harness checked the built page with fixture routing data in English, simplified/traditional Chinese, Japanese and German at desktop and 420px widths; no horizontal document overflow was observed.

No real subscription account, full test suite, or original Playwright suite was run. Browser fixtures verify the explanation, while the separate HTTP tests verify routing. AI-assisted implementation and review.
